title: The Age of Rebirth
blurb: A Fog of Forgetting has rolled across Italy. As a young apprentice in Florence, discover the ideas of the Renaissance and drive the fog back across Europe.
learn: Patrons, humanism, secularism, Renaissance figures such as Lorenzo de' Medici and Leonardo da Vinci, the Reformation, the Scientific Revolution and the rise of absolute monarchs.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to jump.

title: Beyond the Horizon
blurb: Sail uncharted waters with Dias, Columbus, da Gama and Magellan. Steer by compass, survive the storms and race your class around the world.
learn: The great voyages of exploration, the explorers who led them, world geography and the motives and consequences of European expansion.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to steer, or tap a point on the compass rose.

title: Lantern of Reason
blurb: An Enlightenment quest. Explore the map, meet Hobbes, Locke, Montesquieu and Rousseau, and battle for big ideas.
learn: Natural rights, the social contract, separation of powers and the thinkers behind them.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to explore; click or tap to answer.

title: The Last King
blurb: Rule as Louis XVI while the people's anger rises. Every choice and every answer decides how long the monarchy lasts.
learn: The causes of the French Revolution, the Estates, the key events from Versailles to the Republic and the people who shaped them.

title: Full Steam
blurb: The Great Smokestack Climb. Race up a steampunk factory tower. Tired climbers slow down, and the right answer refuels you.
learn: Key inventions, inventors, places and terms of the Industrial Revolution.
controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to jump, E to refuel.

title: Empire Chase
blurb: A maze chase across two map sets: the Scramble for Africa and the Great Game in Asia. Learn the places, earn your stars.
learn: The Scramble for Africa, the Berlin Conference, the Great Game, China's century of humiliation and Japan's rise.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move.

title: Over the Top
blurb: A trench strategy game. Answer to earn credit, build your defenses, time your artillery and go over the top at Verdun, the Somme and beyond.
learn: Key terms, battles, geography and figures of the Great War.

title: Front Line
blurb: Answer fast. Push the line. Win the war. Fly missions in the campaign, climb in Endless Sky or duel a classmate on one screen.
learn: Key terms, people and places of World War II.

title: History Hero
blurb: A battle of knowledge across six centuries. Explore the map, gather scrolls, duel rivals and be the last hero standing.
learn: Review of the whole year: key terms, people and places from the Renaissance to the end of the Cold War.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move; walk up to a rival to duel.
